recent_articles.title: China mine blast: Death toll rises to 82; Beijing orders crackdown as rescue ops continue — top developments - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A deadly gas explosion at a coal mine in Shanxi province, China has killed at least 82 people. The blast occurred on Friday evening at the Liushenyu mine, injuring over 120 others and leaving several missing.  **PM Modi** offered condolences to **President Xi Jinping** and the Chinese people. Authorities launched an investigation into the incident and vowed to crack down on illegal mining practices nationwide. Rescue operations are ongoing, with authorities deploying a large number of emergency personnel.

recent_articles.title: India's Cockroach Janta Party claims website has been blocked
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janta Party** (CJP), an Indian political parody group, claims its website has been blocked in the country just days after launching. The group's founder, Abhijeet Dipke, alleges that Indian officials took down the site and questioned their fear of cockroaches.  Dipke also reported that both his personal Instagram and the CJP's account have been hacked.  The CJP satirizes the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and claims to represent the unemployed youth in India.

recent_articles.title: One more Trinamool councillor from Bidhannagar arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TMC** councillors from the municipality of Bidhannagar, **West Bengal**, have been arrested in recent days for charges including intimidation, violence, extortion, and money laundering.  The arrests follow a crackdown by the new **BJP** government after the 2021 Assembly election. Several other TMC leaders, including a local union leader and a former minister, have also been arrested on various charges. The arrests come amid allegations of post-poll violence and threats against citizens.

recent_articles.title: Government plans to inaugurate Bhogapuram Airport on July 5: MP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M. Sribharat**, an MP, announced that the **State government** plans to inaugurate the International Airport at Bhogapuram on July 5th with Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**.  He expressed confidence that several airlines would soon begin operations from the new airport following its inauguration. Scoot Airlines will commence international services from Bhogapuram Airport starting July 8th.

recent_articles.title: Back Rahul Gandhi’s call for ‘Samvidhan Bachao’, says Jagga Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **T. Jagga Reddy**, a senior Congress leader, defended **Rahul Gandhi**'s "Samvidhan Bachao" campaign, arguing that the Constitution and democratic values are under threat under the current BJP-led government. He compared the Constitution to Karna's armor in the Mahabharata, stating that its protection is vital for citizens' rights and freedoms.  He called for vigilance to safeguard voting rights and constitutional freedoms, highlighting Congress contributions to India's democratic systems throughout history.

recent_articles.title: Chief Electoral Officer (Kerala) Rathan U. Kelkar appointed Secretary to Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rathan U. Kelkar**, the Chief Electoral Officer of **Kerala**, will transition from his role to become the Secretary to **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan**.  Mr. Kelkar, a 2003 batch IAS officer, has been in the news for overseeing the recent Kerala Assembly elections and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The appointment follows the recent appointment of **Manoj Kumar Agarwal** as Chief Secretary to the new BJP government in West Bengal.  The State government will send a panel of names to the Election Commission to appoint a new CEO once Mr. Kelkar is relieved of his duties.

recent_articles.title: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio four-day India visit updates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio** arrived in New Delhi on Saturday (May 23, 2026) for his first official visit to India, aiming to recalibrate bilateral relations that have faced headwinds since mid-last year.  He met with **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and attended a meeting of the Quad Foreign Ministers. The trip comes after a period of strain between the two countries following trade disputes and President Donald Trump's statements regarding the India-Pakistan conflict.  The visit will focus on strengthening ties in areas such as energy, trade, investment, technology, and people-to-people exchanges, with discussions also expected to cover the West Asia crisis and its economic impact.

recent_articles.title: Nomura picks 6 stocks with up to 49% upside potential that can benefit from India’s EV push - EV Boost | The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nomura**, an international brokerage, predicts a surge in **India's** electric vehicle (EV) adoption due to government policies and rising fuel prices. The brokerage recommends six stocks likely to benefit from this trend: **Mahindra & Mahindra**, **Hyundai Motor India**, **TVS Motors**, **Ather Energy**, **Sona BLW Precision Forgings**, and **UNO Minda**. These companies are expected to see significant growth in the near future, with potential upside ranging from 20% to 49%.

recent_articles.title: Innovation begins with understanding the fundamentals: Prakash Balasubramanian - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prakash Balasubramanian**, senior director at **Infineon Technologies**, emphasized the importance of foundational knowledge for technological breakthroughs during the inauguration of "Nirmaan Utsav" in Kalaburagi city. He highlighted the evolution of technologies over decades and urged students to think innovatively. Deputy Commissioner of Police (Law and Order) Shaloo encouraged students to combine academic learning with practical experience and stay updated on emerging fields like drones, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. HKE Society president and MLC Shashil Namoshi noted that **PDA Engineering College** is nurturing future-ready students through events like "Nirmaan Utsav."

recent_articles.title: Bengali actors face heat after power shift to BJP; FIR filed over 2021 social media posts linked to post-poll violence - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parambrata Chatterjee**, a Bengali actor, announced he had to align with the **Trinamool Congress** after the recent West Bengal Assembly election results.  He stated this decision was made for his one-year-old son, prompting strong reactions from social media users and fellow actors. **Keya Ghosh**, a BJP leader, responded by criticizing Chatterjee's compromise and highlighting the unwavering support of many BJP supporters in the state.

recent_articles.title: Elected government has no role in Jammu demolitions, says Farooq Abdullah - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Farooq Abdullah**, president of the **National Conference (NC)**, stated that the elected government has no involvement in the ongoing demolitions in Jammu.  He accused the opposition parties of pursuing anti-Gujjar policies and claimed that Gujjars and Bakerwals have historically protected the region's borders. **Gulam Ali Khatana**, a BJP Rajya Sabha member, countered by accusing the NC and Congress of neglecting the development of Gujjar and Pahari communities for decades. He praised the Modi government's efforts to empower these communities.

recent_articles.title: Rajasthan Cabinet approves new industrial development policy with focus on talent economy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan** Cabinet approved a new industrial development policy focused on talent economy and private sector participation to create a world-class industrial infrastructure.  **Industries and Commerce Minister Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore** stated the policy would provide incentives for micro, small, and medium enterprises, one district one product, and the export sector. The policy aims to boost the state's economy to $350 billion by 2028-29.  The Cabinet also approved decisions on energy production, water conservation, and pensioners' welfare.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan gets its own ‘Cockroach Awaam Party’ as India’s viral CJP sparks cross-border satire wave - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan** has seen the emergence of satirical political groups inspired by the **Cockroach Janta Party**, a viral movement in India.  These groups, such as the **Cockroach Awami Party** and **Cockroach Awami League**, have emerged on social media platforms like Instagram and X, mirroring the Indian party's focus on issues affecting unemployed youth, including education, healthcare, and employment opportunities. The Pakistani groups use similar slogans and branding to their Indian counterparts, positioning themselves as alternative voices to mainstream political parties in Pakistan.

recent_articles.title: Rubio's maiden India visit aims to repair strained ties; boost Quad cooperation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio** will visit **India** from May 23 to 26, 2026, aiming to repair strained bilateral ties.  He will meet with **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar**, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, and attend a Quad Foreign Ministers meeting in New Delhi. The trip follows a recent three-day visit by **India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri** to Washington DC focused on stabilizing the relationship.  The talks are expected to focus on bolstering ties in energy, trade, investment, critical technology, and people-to-people exchanges, as well as discussing the West Asia crisis and its economic impact.

recent_articles.title: Picked wrong Melody? Parle Industries shares hit 5% upper circuit for 3rd day - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: During a visit to Italy, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** gifted **Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni** a bag of candies called "Melody." The viral video of the exchange sparked interest in Indian brands and led to marketing campaigns by companies like **Air India**.  The candy's maker, **Parle Products**, confirmed it is exported to 100 countries. While Parle Industries shares saw a significant jump following the incident, the company has no immediate plans for an initial public offering.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan elected Kerala Speaker - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan**, a senior Congress leader, was elected as the Speaker of the 16th Kerala Legislative Assembly on Friday (May 22, 2026). He won with 101 votes, defeating **A.C. Moideen** and **B.B. Gopakumar**.  The election took place after **G. Sudhakaran**, the previous Pro Tem Speaker, chose not to vote.  **V.D. Satheesan**, the Chief Minister, and **Pinarayi Vijayan**, the Leader of the Opposition, led Radhakrishnan to the Speaker's chair.

recent_articles.title: Voter confusion fears over simultaneous polls ‘misplaced’, says ONOE JPC chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. Chaudhary**, chairman of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on ‘One Nation One Election’, defended the proposal, arguing that Indian voters are politically astute and can differentiate between national and state issues.  He cited examples from Delhi and other states where voters supported different parties in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections. **CII**, **ASSOCHAM**, and **GCCI** backed the proposal, while **Gujarat University Vice-Chancellor Dr. Neerja Gupta** highlighted how frequent polls disrupt academic schedules and increase financial costs. The committee also heard concerns from the **Congress**, which argued that simultaneous elections would allow national narratives to overshadow state issues.

recent_articles.title: Lakshmi could have been a child bride - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lakshmi**, a 16-year-old girl from Uttar Pradesh, wrote a song expressing her desire to continue her education and resist early marriage. Her father initially dismissed the message but was persuaded by **anganwadi workers** and **village pradhan**.  The village now features painted messages advocating for change in response to Lakshmi's powerful lyrics.

recent_articles.title: Congress workers clash with police in Jaipur during stir against NEET-UG paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party workers clashed with **police** in **Rajasthan** on Thursday during a protest against the NEET-UG exam paper leak.  Led by **State Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra**, the protesters demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and the dissolution of the **National Testing Agency**. The demonstrators, carrying banners and placards, were forcibly dispersed using water cannons. Some protesters suffered minor injuries.

recent_articles.title: BJP functionary’s request to HR&CE Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vinoj Selvam**, a BJP functionary, urged newly appointed **Ramesh**, the Minister for Hindu Religious & Charitable Endowments, to only worship at the Srirangam temple if he visits.  Selvam's statement followed social media posts showing **Ramesh** with images of late social reformer 'Periyar' E.V. Ramasamy.

recent_articles.title: Ladakh leaders to meet Home Ministry officials on May 22, Sonam Wangchuk part of delegation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A delegation from Ladakh, including climate activist **Sonam Wangchuk**, is meeting with **Union Home Ministry** officials on Friday to discuss demands for constitutional safeguards such as Statehood and inclusion under the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution. This meeting follows a previous inconclusive high-powered committee meeting in February and comes after the violence in Leh city in September 2025, which stalled talks.  The delegation will reiterate their demands for Statehood, while officials have offered safeguards under Article 371 of the Constitution.

recent_articles.title: Take forward reforms, PM tells Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** convened a full Council of Ministers meeting in New Delhi on Thursday, May 21, 2026. The session focused on the government's reform agenda amidst geopolitical shifts and saw presentations from various ministries including labor, power, commerce, finance, agriculture, railways, and NITI Aayog.  The meetings reviewed past achievements and future plans, outlining targets for each ministry.

recent_articles.title: Himachal urban poll results reflect public confidence in Congress; party united with no groupism, says CM Sukhu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu**, Chief Minister of **Himachal Pradesh**, attributed the Congress-backed candidates' victory in recent urban local body elections to public approval of the party's governance. He highlighted the sustained popularity despite anti-incumbency pressures and emphasized a unified effort among party workers.  He also criticized the BJP for its perceived lack of support for Himachal Pradesh, particularly regarding issues like the Revenue Deficit Grant and natural disasters. Sukhu asserted that the Congress has fulfilled its promises and exceeded expectations in delivering on commitments such as welfare schemes and reforms in education and healthcare.

recent_articles.title: Parody Cockroach Janta political party’s rise reflects youth anger in India | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A satirical online movement, the Cockroach Janta (People's) party, has gained significant traction in India.  **Abhijeet Dipke**, a political communications strategist and student at Boston University, founded the movement after **Surya Kant**, the Supreme Court chief justice, sparked backlash with comments comparing unemployed young people to cockroaches. The CJP uses absurdist humor to mock corruption, joblessness, and government dysfunction, attracting millions of followers on social media.  While some dismiss it as a digital gimmick, Dipke believes it reflects mounting frustration among India's youth and could lead to real political change.

recent_articles.title: From rallies to reels: political catchphrases turn dance anthems in Kolkata - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A new genre of political techno remixes has emerged in Kolkata, using catchy hooks and meme-friendly punchlines to criticize politicians. The trend began with songs like "Khela Hobe" and continues with remixed versions of "Hamba Hamba", "Mach Chor", and "File Chor". These songs often target specific individuals or parties, gaining popularity through social media platforms like Instagram and YouTube Shorts.  The use of crude humor and satirical lyrics reflects a culture of insult-flinging on social media while also expressing anger towards political leaders who abuse power.

recent_articles.title: India's 'Cockroach Janta Party' goes viral, spotlights Gen Z worries - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A five-day-old group called the **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)** has gained significant traction in India, surpassing the Instagram followers of the ruling **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.  The CJP, founded by 30-year-old Abhijeet Dipke, addresses issues like unemployment, inflation, and political representation, resonating with a large segment of young Indians who feel ignored by mainstream politics. The group's rapid growth reflects the anxieties felt by India's youth, as highlighted in a recent Deloitte Global survey that found Gen Z facing financial stress and postponing major life decisions due to economic concerns. Dipke emphasizes the CJP's commitment to democratic and peaceful means of political engagement, while also acknowledging its potential for significant change within Indian politics.

recent_articles.title: Bihar midday meal incident: HC asks whether NGO can continue providing meals - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Patna High Court** has expressed concern over delays in the investigation of a midday meal incident where over 150 students fell ill in Saharsa district. The court questioned whether the NGO supplying meals to over 1,800 students should continue operations during the probe and raised concerns about discrepancies in food sample collection and testing.  The court directed officials to file affidavits explaining the processes involved. The matter will be heard again on June 2nd.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal government to detect, delete and deport illegal infiltrators, says CM Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, West Bengal Chief Minister, announced a new policy of "detect, delete, and deport" for illegal infiltrators.  He stated that the state police will arrest those not covered under the Citizenship (Amendment) Act and hand them over to the **Border Security Force (BSF)** for deportation. The announcement was made during an event where land was handed over to the BSF for border fencing along 27 km of the India-Bangladesh border.  The Chief Minister also emphasized the revival of district-level coordination mechanisms between the BSF, state police, and administration in bordering areas.

recent_articles.title: Mega merger incoming: Should you buy PFC, REC shares ahead of merger? Here's what analysts say - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nirmala Sitharaman**, the **Union Finance Minister**, announced plans to restructure **Power Finance Corporation (PFC)** and **Rural Electrification Corporation (REC)** for streamlined operations. The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved a proposal where PFC acquired 52.63% of the government's holding in REC, consolidating them into a single balance sheet.  Analysts suggest investors consider staggered exposure to PFC and REC as the merger process is subject to regulatory approvals and structural adjustments. While PFC offers better visibility due to its parent status, REC presents a merger-arbitrage opportunity with higher event risk depending on the swap ratio.

recent_articles.title: After State-run schools, Vande Mataram now compulsory in all Bengal madrasas - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: West Bengal Directorate of Madrasa Education
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **West Bengal Directorate of Madrasa Education** has mandated the singing of "Vande Mataram" during assembly prayers in all government, aided, and recognized madrasas across the state. The order, issued by the Director of Madrasa Education, states that this is effective immediately and supersedes previous practices.  This decision follows a similar mandate for state-run schools announced earlier in May.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar challenges BJP leaders to travel by public transport daily - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister of **Karnataka**, criticized **BJP** leaders for using public transport only for photoshoots in response to the Prime Minister's call for austerity measures. He challenged them to travel by public transport daily, questioning the sincerity of their actions.  He also addressed the Prime Minister's call to abstain from buying gold and expressed his commitment to visit Delhi when called upon by **Rahul Gandhi**, Leader of the Opposition.

recent_articles.title: After High Court verdict, Hindu petitioners seek free entry for devotees at Bhojshala in Madhya Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hindu** petitioners have filed applications with the **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** and the **Union Culture Ministry**, demanding free entry to the Bhojshala complex and the removal of "unauthorised Islamic symbols". They also requested that idols of Lord Hanuman and other Hindu deities be retrieved through a scientific excavation. The **Madhya Pradesh High Court** had declared the site a Vagdevi temple on May 15, quashing an earlier order allowing Muslims to offer namaz there.

recent_articles.title: Parle Industries hits upper circuit amid ‘Melody’ confusion - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parle Industries** shares surged 5% on Wednesday after a social media video showed **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** giving a 'Melody' toffee to his Italian counterpart, **Giorgia Meloni**. The stock's trading volume spiked significantly, exceeding its two-week average. This is not an isolated incident; similar mix-ups have occurred in the past with companies like LG Electronics India and Tata Motors, highlighting the potential for confusion among retail investors during market volatility.

recent_articles.title: PM busy handing out candies in Italy amid economic storm at home, says Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's economic policies, accusing it of prioritizing publicity over addressing rising inflation, unemployment, and weakening economic indicators.  **Kharge** highlighted the increase in average debt per Indian and wealth concentration among billionaires, while **Gandhi** criticized the Prime Minister's focus on foreign trips during a time of economic distress. Congress officials also pointed to the rupee's decline, falling foreign exchange reserves, and large investor outflows as evidence of government mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: No double standards, we condemn Russia, U.S. and Israel for international law violations: Norway’s Foreign Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Espen Barth Eide**, **Norwegian Foreign Minister**, urged **India** and **Norway** to increase their engagement to avoid becoming overly reliant on any single global power.  He highlighted the potential for increased trade, technology transfer, and renewable energy cooperation as key areas of focus. While Norway prefers India reduce its reliance on Russian oil, it acknowledges India's concerns regarding energy security.

recent_articles.title: Modi, Shah are traitors who are attacking the Constitution, says Rahul at Rae Bareli meet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress** party, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, accusing them of attacking the Constitution and supporting industrialists. He also warned of an impending economic crisis, stating that it would disproportionately affect ordinary citizens while benefiting those in power.  Gandhi unveiled a statue of Veera Pasi in Rae Bareli, highlighting his party's renewed focus on the community. He further criticized the BJP government over land acquisition policies and unemployment rates, vowing to fight for the rights of the people.

recent_articles.title: Average of 53% MPs attend meetings of 16 Parliamentary Standing Committees, PAC: data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has been raising concerns about the low attendance of members at parliamentary committees.  Data shows that an average of 53% of members attended meetings of 16 department-related Standing Committees and the Public Accounts Committee since their reconstitution last September, with five meetings postponed due to a lack of quorum. The data also reveals that nearly 47% of members were absent from these meetings, with better attendance observed in committees focused on Railways, Petroleum and Natural Gas, External Affairs, and Finance.  The Standing Committees discussed various important subjects including India-Sri Lanka relations, the review of the working of Border Roads Organisation (BRO), research and technology development in renewable energy, and safety and security of the diaspora during the ongoing conflict in West Asia.

recent_articles.title: Athlete Swapna Barman becomes victim of poll violence, house attacked - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swapna Barman**, an Asian Games gold medalist and Trinamool Congress candidate, reported that her property was set on fire by unidentified individuals after the 2026 West Bengal Assembly election. **Abhishek Banerjee**, a Trinamool Congress general secretary, accused **BJP** supporters of the arson attack and claimed it reflects the "violence, intimidation, and fear" directed at Trinamool supporters.  The **BJP** government has denied these allegations while **Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari** pledged to ensure the safety of those displaced by violence.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: Medical Education Minister demands court-monitored probe into NEET paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil** criticized the ongoing investigation into the NEET question paper leak, calling for a court-monitored probe. He expressed concerns that the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)**'s current investigation lacked transparency and confidence, suggesting powerful individuals were involved in orchestrating the scandal to manipulate MBBS seat sales.

recent_articles.title: BJP protests State government’s decision to withdraw uniform rule in educational institutions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJP** district unit members protested against the **State government's** decision to withdraw uniform regulations in educational institutions, arguing that it would disrupt discipline and academic atmosphere. The protesters, including former MP Umesh Jadhav and BJP leaders Baburao Chavan, Sudha Halkai, Chandrakant Patil, and Ashok Bagli, demanded intervention from the Governor to retain the policy. They claimed uniforms promote secular values and reduce socioeconomic disparities among students.

recent_articles.title: Remove Bandi Sanjay from Union Cabinet, Kavitha tells Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalvakuntla Kavitha**, president of the **Telangana Rakshana Sena**, urged **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to remove **Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar** from his position until the investigation and trial in the POCSO case involving his son are complete.  Kavitha expressed concern over potential conflict of interest and a perception of political influence on the investigation, arguing that public trust in the justice system could be damaged by Mr. Kumar's continued presence in office.

recent_articles.title: Push for public transport exposes structural gaps - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** push for public transport, particularly metro rail, has prompted politicians and bureaucrats to use such systems. However, the renewed spotlight on public transit highlights a gap between policy intent and on-ground delivery.  Years of underinvestment in mass rapid transit systems have led to stalled projects like the Hyderabad Metro’s second phase and the Multi-Modal Transport System (MMTS) network. While efforts are underway to improve connectivity and funding, challenges remain, including securing approvals for expansion and procuring new train sets. The State government is also exploring a Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS), but its suitability for urban settings remains questioned.

recent_articles.title: BRICS is evolving with new members; differences will take time to resolve: Brazil FM Mauro Vieira - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BRICS** Foreign Ministers meeting in Delhi concluded with a detailed Chair Statement supporting Indian initiatives and the Palestinian cause, but failed to reach consensus on positions regarding the war in West Asia.  Despite disagreements, **Mauro Vieira**, Brazilian Foreign Minister, emphasized the continued importance of **BRICS**.

recent_articles.title: KTR asks party leaders and BLAs to be alert during SIR - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K.T. Rama Rao**, working president of the **Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, met with Assembly Constituency in-charges to discuss electoral roll revisions and membership drives. He cautioned against potential voter suppression by **Congress** and **BJP**.  He urged party members to protect voters' rights and expose the opposing parties' policies. At a separate meeting with Sanathnagar constituency activists, **KTR** stated that the BJP has minimal presence in the state and their Lok Sabha election performance was an anomaly.

recent_articles.title: Manoj Jarange warns of fresh agitation over Maratha quota issue from May 30 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Manoj Jarange**, a Maratha quota activist, announced an indefinite hunger strike beginning May 30th over the **Maharashtra** government's failure to distribute Kunbi caste certificates and implement other demands.  Jarange demanded the dissolution of the Maratha quota sub-committee and urged for a separate ministry for the Maratha and Kunbi communities. He also criticized the state government for halting the issuance of Kunbi caste certificates, claiming that officials have been instructed not to issue them. **Devendra Fadnavis**, the Chief Minister of **Maharashtra**, has been accused by Jarange of being responsible for these actions.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi arrives in Netherlands on second leg of five-nation tour - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** arrived in the Netherlands on Friday, May 15, 2026, for a two-day visit to further strengthen bilateral cooperation. **Modi** met with **Dutch counterpart Rob Jetten**, and will also meet with King Willem-Alexander and Queen Maxima. The visit is part of a five-nation tour that includes stops in Sweden, Norway, and Italy.  The trip comes as the India-EU Free Trade Agreement has been finalized, and the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement was signed in 2025.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi in Netherlands LIVE: Prime Minister lauds Dutch coach’s role in Indian women’s hockey success - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** arrived in the Netherlands on Friday, May 15, 2026, for a two-day visit to further strengthen bilateral ties. **Mr. Modi** met with his Dutch counterpart, **Rob Jetten**, and was welcomed by senior officials from both countries, including **Rear Admiral Ludger Brummelaar**. The visit marks an important juncture in the India-Netherlands relationship, which has expanded beyond traditional sectors into areas like technology, defense, and renewable energy.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Youth Congress protests in Delhi, chief Uday Bhanu Chib detained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Indian Youth Congress (IYC)** staged a protest in New Delhi demanding the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** over alleged NEET-UG question paper leaks.  Protesters, including IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib, were detained by police as they marched towards **Pradhan's** residence. The examination was cancelled on May 3rd and a re-test is scheduled for June 21st. The IYC accused the BJP-led government of creating a corrupt system that favors wealthy students while disadvantaging those from poor backgrounds.

recent_articles.title: Fuel price hike negatively impacts economy, triggers rise in essential commodity prices: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A Revanth Reddy**, **Telangana Chief Minister**, criticized the **Union Government’s** decision to increase petrol and diesel prices, arguing it would negatively impact the economy and ordinary citizens.
